name: timeline
description: Use The Timeline as cited workspace memory through one general agent skill and its hosted MCP connection.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to The Timeline's cited workspace memory. One general skill teaches agents how to choose MCP tools, expand source evidence, distinguish current state from activity, and adapt cited answers to the request. OAuth read access follows the consenting member's visibility; optional owner/admin-approved agent access may create reviewable proposals and call enabled team-shared tools.
